title: Crypto.prng, crypto.pseudoRandomBytes and crypto.rng are deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates crypto.prng, crypto.pseudoRandomBytes and crypto.rng (DEP0115: documentation-only since v11.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of crypto.prng, crypto.pseudoRandomBytes and crypto.rng with crypto.randomBytes().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
